headline: Japanese Automakers Seek to Halve Vehicle Development Cycles Against Chinese Rivals
summary: Japanese carmakers are moving to cut vehicle development timelines from four years to counter Chinese competitors developing new models in less than half that time.
why: Japan's automotive sector is a core export driver; maintaining speed-to-market is critical to defending global market share against rapid Chinese electric and smart vehicle launches.

impacts.name: Automotive
impacts.why: Accelerating R&D cycles requires higher upfront investment but helps protect competitive positioning against fast Chinese rivals.
